tob-0038-d5: Church Committee Volume VI prints the Senate hearings on the FBI — senators grilling Bureau men on spying at home. The testimony covers COINTELPRO and the watch kept on citizens. The exchanges are often electric. The hearings are the public face of the probe.
tob-0039-d5: This microfilm roll holds a further part of the Doctors’ Trial record from Nuremberg — the case against the Nazi medical machine. The court’s record notes every witness and ruling. The trial stands as a landmark in the law of war crimes.
